title: Uniaxial Compression of Neo-Hookean Cartilage Cube
description: Single-element hex8 FEBio 4.0 biomechanical model of articular cartilage modeled as a compressible Neo-Hookean solid under unconfined uniaxial compression.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<febio_spec version="4.0">
  <Module type="solid"/>
  <Control>
    <analysis>STATIC</analysis>
    <time_steps>10</time_steps>
    <step_size>0.1</step_size>
  </Control>
  <Material>
    <material id="1" name="ArticularCartilage" type="neo-Hookean">
      <E>1.2</E>
      <v>0.42</v>
      <density>1.10</density>
    </material>
  </Material>
  <Mesh>
    <Nodes name="CartilageNodes">
      <node id="1">0.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="2">1.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="3">1.0, 1.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="4">0.0, 1.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="5">0.0, 0.0, 1.0</node>
      <node id="6">1.0, 0.0, 1.0</node>
      <node id="7">1.0, 1.0, 1.0</node>
      <node id="8">0.0, 1.0, 1.0</node>
    </Nodes>
    <Elements type="hex8" name="CartilageDomain">
      <elem id="1">1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8</elem>
    </Elements>
    <NodeSet name="BottomFace">
      <node id="1"/>
      <node id="2"/>
      <node id="3"/>
      <node id="4"/>
    </NodeSet>
    <NodeSet name="TopFace">
      <node id="5"/>
      <node id="6"/>
      <node id="7"/>
      <node id="8"/>
    </NodeSet>
  </Mesh>
  <MeshDomains>
    <SolidDomain name="CartilageDomain" mat="1"/>
  </MeshDomains>
  <Boundary>
    <bc name="FixBottom" type="zero displacement" node_set="BottomFace">
      <x_dof>1</x_dof>
      <y_dof>1</y_dof>
      <z_dof>1</z_dof>
    </bc>
    <bc name="CompressTop" type="prescribed displacement" node_set="TopFace">
      <dof>z</dof>
      <value>-0.15</value>
    </bc>
  </Boundary>
</febio_spec>

title: Mooney-Rivlin Arterial Wall Inflation Pressure Test
description: Hyperelastic Mooney-Rivlin vascular wall patch subjected to physiological systolic blood pressure (16 kPa) on the luminal surface with clamped boundary edges.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<febio_spec version="4.0">
  <Module type="solid"/>
  <Control>
    <analysis>STATIC</analysis>
    <time_steps>20</time_steps>
    <step_size>0.05</step_size>
  </Control>
  <Material>
    <material id="1" name="ArterialMedia" type="Mooney-Rivlin">
      <c1>0.045</c1>
      <c2>0.015</c2>
      <k>10.0</k>
      <density>1.06</density>
    </material>
  </Material>
  <Mesh>
    <Nodes name="ArteryNodes">
      <node id="1">0.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="2">5.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="3">5.0, 5.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="4">0.0, 5.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="5">0.0, 0.0, 1.2</node>
      <node id="6">5.0, 0.0, 1.2</node>
      <node id="7">5.0, 5.0, 1.2</node>
      <node id="8">0.0, 5.0, 1.2</node>
    </Nodes>
    <Elements type="hex8" name="ArteryWall">
      <elem id="1">1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8</elem>
    </Elements>
    <NodeSet name="ClampedEnds">
      <node id="1"/>
      <node id="4"/>
      <node id="5"/>
      <node id="8"/>
    </NodeSet>
    <Surface name="LumenSurface">
      <quad4 id="1">1, 2, 3, 4</quad4>
    </Surface>
  </Mesh>
  <MeshDomains>
    <SolidDomain name="ArteryWall" mat="1"/>
  </MeshDomains>
  <Boundary>
    <bc name="FixArteryEnd" type="zero displacement" node_set="ClampedEnds">
      <x_dof>1</x_dof>
      <y_dof>1</y_dof>
      <z_dof>1</z_dof>
    </bc>
  </Boundary>
  <Loads>
    <surface_load name="SystolicPressure" type="pressure" surface="LumenSurface">
      <pressure>0.016</pressure>
    </surface_load>
  </Loads>
</febio_spec>

title: Ogden Hyperelastic Tendon Tensile Stretch
description: Two-element tetrahedral Achilles tendon fascicle modeled with a nonlinear Ogden hyperelastic strain-energy function under 8% axial physiological tensile elongation.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<febio_spec version="4.0">
  <Module type="solid"/>
  <Control>
    <analysis>STATIC</analysis>
    <time_steps>25</time_steps>
    <step_size>0.04</step_size>
  </Control>
  <Material>
    <material id="1" name="AchillesTendon" type="Ogden">
      <c1>12.5</c1>
      <m1>4.2</m1>
      <k>250.0</k>
      <density>1.12</density>
    </material>
  </Material>
  <Mesh>
    <Nodes name="TendonNodes">
      <node id="1">0.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="2">4.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="3">0.0, 4.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="4">0.0, 0.0, 20.0</node>
      <node id="5">4.0, 0.0, 20.0</node>
    </Nodes>
    <Elements type="tet4" name="TendonFascicle">
      <elem id="1">1, 2, 3, 4</elem>
      <elem id="2">2, 5, 3, 4</elem>
    </Elements>
    <NodeSet name="CalcaneusAnchor">
      <node id="1"/>
      <node id="2"/>
      <node id="3"/>
    </NodeSet>
    <NodeSet name="MyotendinousEnd">
      <node id="4"/>
      <node id="5"/>
    </NodeSet>
  </Mesh>
  <MeshDomains>
    <SolidDomain name="TendonFascicle" mat="1"/>
  </MeshDomains>
  <Boundary>
    <bc name="FixDistal" type="zero displacement" node_set="CalcaneusAnchor">
      <x_dof>1</x_dof>
      <y_dof>1</y_dof>
      <z_dof>1</z_dof>
    </bc>
    <bc name="AxialTension" type="prescribed displacement" node_set="MyotendinousEnd">
      <dof>z</dof>
      <value>1.6</value>
    </bc>
  </Boundary>
</febio_spec>

title: SOFA Real-Time Soft-Tissue Liver Deformation Scene
description: SOFA Framework surgical simulation scene graph (.scn) modeling hepatic parenchyma as a corotational tetrahedral FEM mesh with fixed ligament attachment and laparoscopic retraction.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Node name="LiverSurgicalScene" dt="0.005" gravity="0 -9.81 0">
  <Node name="LiverParenchymaFEM">
    <EulerImplicitSolver name="ImplicitSolver" rayleighStiffness="0.1" rayleighMass="0.1" />
    <CGLinearSolver name="LinearSolver" iterations="25" tolerance="1e-6" threshold="1e-6" />
    <MechanicalObject name="dofs" position="0 0 0  40 0 0  0 35 0  0 0 30  40 0 30" />
    <TetrahedronSetTopologyContainer name="topo" tetrahedra="0 1 2 3  1 4 2 3" />
    <DiagonalMass name="LiverMass" massDensity="1.05" />
    <TetrahedronFEMForceField name="HepaticFEM" youngModulus="4500" poissonRatio="0.45" method="large" />
    <FixedConstraint name="FalciformLigamentAnchor" indices="0 1 2" />
  </Node>
</Node>

title: Biphasic Porohyperelastic Knee Meniscus Contact Analysis
description: Multi-file FEBio 4.0 biphasic poroelastic knee meniscus and femoral condyle cartilage sliding contact model with physiological gait load curve data.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<febio_spec version="4.0">
  <Module type="biphasic"/>
  <Control>
    <analysis>TRANSIENT</analysis>
    <time_steps>40</time_steps>
    <step_size>0.025</step_size>
  </Control>
  <Material>
    <material id="1" name="MeniscusBiphasic" type="biphasic">
      <phi0>0.25</phi0>
      <solid type="neo-Hookean">
        <E>0.85</E>
        <v>0.30</v>
        <density>1.08</density>
      </solid>
      <permeability type="perm-const-iso">
        <perm>0.0012</perm>
      </permeability>
    </material>
    <material id="2" name="FemoralCartilage" type="neo-Hookean">
      <E>1.50</E>
      <v>0.40</v>
      <density>1.10</density>
    </material>
  </Material>
  <Mesh>
    <Nodes name="KneeJointNodes">
      <node id="1">0.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="2">10.0, 0.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="3">10.0, 10.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="4">0.0, 10.0, 0.0</node>
      <node id="5">0.0, 0.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="6">10.0, 0.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="7">10.0, 10.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="8">0.0, 10.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="9">0.0, 0.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="10">10.0, 0.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="11">10.0, 10.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="12">0.0, 10.0, 4.0</node>
      <node id="13">0.0, 0.0, 7.0</node>
      <node id="14">10.0, 0.0, 7.0</node>
      <node id="15">10.0, 10.0, 7.0</node>
      <node id="16">0.0, 10.0, 7.0</node>
    </Nodes>
    <Elements type="hex8" name="MeniscusDomain">
      <elem id="1">1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8</elem>
    </Elements>
    <Elements type="hex8" name="CondyleDomain">
      <elem id="2">9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16</elem>
    </Elements>
    <NodeSet name="TibialPlateauBase">
      <node id="1"/>
      <node id="2"/>
      <node id="3"/>
      <node id="4"/>
    </NodeSet>
    <NodeSet name="CondyleTop">
      <node id="13"/>
      <node id="14"/>
      <node id="15"/>
      <node id="16"/>
    </NodeSet>
    <Surface name="MeniscusSuperior">
      <quad4 id="1">5, 6, 7, 8</quad4>
    </Surface>
    <Surface name="CondyleInferior">
      <quad4 id="2">9, 10, 11, 12</quad4>
    </Surface>
  </Mesh>
  <MeshDomains>
    <SolidDomain name="MeniscusDomain" mat="1"/>
    <SolidDomain name="CondyleDomain" mat="2"/>
  </MeshDomains>
  <Boundary>
    <bc name="FixTibia" type="zero displacement" node_set="TibialPlateauBase">
      <x_dof>1</x_dof>
      <y_dof>1</y_dof>
      <z_dof>1</z_dof>
    </bc>
    <bc name="CondyleCompression" type="prescribed displacement" node_set="CondyleTop">
      <dof>z</dof>
      <value>-0.45</value>
    </bc>
  </Boundary>
  <contact name="MeniscusCondyleContact" type="sliding-elastic" primary="MeniscusSuperior" secondary="CondyleInferior" penalty="100.0"/>
</febio_spec>
